# The court: asphalt X -4.6..4.6, Z -1.52..11 (world), one quad textured from above with
# textures/court.png (0.075 m a texel): worn patches, white lines, a purple key, the six blue
# shooting spots, a drain. Generated by make_env.py.
new
add mesh grid --name Court --size 1 --x-subdivisions 4 --y-subdivisions 6 --location 0.0 -4.74 0
scale 9.2 12.52 1
apply --scale
material new Court --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material assign Court
active Court
mode edit
select all
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
material texture Court base-color textures/court.png
shade flat
export court.glb
